sampleNote.title: Welcome to Noolingo
sampleNote.content:
At Noolingo, we track every learning feedback you provide and use it to deliver more precise learning guidance.

You can clearly see your mastery level through the color of each note. The algorithm schedules review times for this content, and you can also adjust them manually.

Noolingo supports Markdown syntax with extensions. You can wrap important content with {{}} brackets, which will be hidden during review to easily strengthen active recall.
